as_told.title: Lawrence Bell's 1956 claim of nuclear fuels to cancel gravity

related.note: Same 1956 article and the same quote about working with nuclear fuels to cancel out gravity, but the story gives it to George Trimble and this telling gives it to Lawrence Bell.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a 1956 magazine article saying that beating gravity was just around the corner. According to Michels, Lawrence Bell, head of the aircraft maker Bell Aircraft, is quoted in it saying his people were already working with nuclear fuels to cancel out gravity. If true, it would mean serious anti-gravity research was under way in the 1950s.
